title: I had a “Deja vu” experience walking around a mall and it gave me a “flashback” to my recurring mall dreams
content: 80% of my dreams take place in malls every since I was younger . One day I went to go do an online order pickup at a mall I had not been to in a while . I suddenly felt like I was in one of my dreams. The mall wasn’t abandoned, but it was much quieter than it used to be, with only a few people around. The mall had an outdated aesthetic I want to say like a late 90s early 2000s interior. It was decorated for Christmas, and the atmosphere felt nostalgic, like a place that used to be much busier. And I jad such a weird feeling I was walking by this giant Christmas tree and the decorations. And I remembered when the line to see Santa was so long but now it was just empty. The mall use to be a very popular mall had all trendy store but in the last couple of years alot of stores have left and the mall was almost dead. It was such a giant space but it was so quiet and barely anyone was in this big mall. And previously when I visited this mall it was very busy but now it was just almost empty. Everything looked exactly like in my dreams, and it gave me a strange feeling, as if I had been there before, even though I knew I hadn’t.
